title: Android 10 Notification Arrow
symptom: After upgrading to Android 10 on a Pixel 3, the arrows in the notification that used to point to 0, 45, 90, 135 and 180 degrees now seem to be flipped so they point to 225, 270, etc. Restarting did not help.
evidence_quote: Since upgrading to Android 10 on a Pixel 3, the arrows that use to point to 0, 45, 90, 135 and 180 degrees now seem to be flipped so they point to 225 (as shown in this picture, 270 etc.
